hooks.name: EU AI compliance — prompt
hooks.description: Checks every submitted prompt against the EU AI compliance policy service (POST /v1/check). BLOCK or ASK exit non-zero and block the submission (IDE; on CLI/Web a Prompt Submit hook cannot block, so the reason is shown as context). WARN exits 0 and adds the obligations to the agent context. Requires guardrails-hook on PATH and the service reachable at GUARDRAILS_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8080). Copy to .kiro/hooks/ in the project (or ~/.kiro/hooks/ for every workspace).
